results.name: name syntax follows Excel's rules (web-checked): letters/_ first, no spaces, not A1/R1C1-like, not C/R, ≤255
names in formulas: ranges, constants, formula names, chains; case-insensitive; unknown → #NAME? until defined
scope: a sheet-level name shadows the workbook name on its sheet only; self-reference terminates with #NAME?
insert/delete rows and columns move names like cell formulas; deleting the whole range gives #REF!
workbook JSON round-trips names; hostile JSON names (invalid syntax, A1-like, oversized) are dropped
openpyxl-authored workbook → our reader: workbook/sheet/formula/constant names evaluate to Python-computed values; hidden and _xlnm names skipped
our writer → openpyxl sees the same names/scopes/destinations, and the PyPI `formulas` engine computes the same results from OUR file
